notes: I replaced the "uppercase followed by letter" rule with a much simpler one: strip outer whitespace, then remove a leading uppercase `H`. This fits every observation — `Zz`, `Qq`, `A`, `I`, `X1`, `A1!`, `A b` are all kept, while every `H`-leading string (`Hello`, `HELLO`, `Hello World`, `Hello!`, `H ello`, `H3llo`, `H`) loses its `H`.
